Keep everything. Finish the interface, the feedback and check the template. Add this section to game_spec.json:
{"text":{"controlsKeyboard":"D F J K (or arrows): hit the lanes","controlsTouch":"Tap the lanes","win":"Song clear!","lose":"Out of rhythm","perfect":"Perfect","good":"Good","miss":"Miss","combo":"Combo","accuracy":"Accuracy","maxCombo":"Max combo"}}

HUD (anchored to visible screen edges + safe margin)
- Top-left: score (large), multiplier "x3" in special color below.
- Top-center: song progress bar (track line, fill player) and health bar under it (fill positive, hazard below 25 %).
- Top-right: pause button.
- Combo number centered above the hit line when combo >= 5 (text.combo).
- Judgement popup above the lane's receptor: text.perfect in positive, text.good in player, text.miss in hazard.

SCREENS
- Title: lanes and receptors pulsing on a 120 BPM beat (silent until the first gesture), title, best, control hints text.controlsKeyboard / text.controlsTouch (highlight the last input type used), text.tapToStart.
- Result: text.win or text.lose, score, best with "New best!", text.accuracy %, text.maxCombo, Perfect/Good/Miss counts, buttons Play again and Menu.

FEEDBACK AND SOUND (style.feedback, audio.sfx)
- Every beat: receptors pulse to 1.08x, driven by the song clock.
- Any press: receptor flash. Perfect: burst in positive + popup. Good: small burst in player + popup. Miss: note fades, popup, light shake, miss sound.
- Multiplier goes up: badge pop + powerup sound. Result: win or lose sound.

DEBUG OVERLAY (when debug.showFps)
FPS, active notes, clock source (A audio / B game time), songTime, last hit error in ms, average hit error of the last 20 hits (to tune rules.audioOffset). debug.invincible: health never drops.

ACCEPTANCE CHECK (fix anything that fails, then report)
1. D F J K and arrows, mouse clicks in lane zones, multi-touch taps all hit the right lane; chords work.
2. Notes cross the hit line exactly on the kick with audioOffset 0; average hit error near 0 when tapping on the beat.
3. Perfect/Good/Miss follow the windows; combo resets on miss; multiplier follows multiplierSteps.
4. Health: misses drain more late in the song, hits refill; 0 = lose, song end = win.
5. With YouTube audio disabled or no Web Audio, fully playable and in sync.
6. SDK pause mid-song, resume: 2 s rewind, in sync, no note judged twice.
7. Editing chart.sequence or a pattern changes the notes and the song together.
8. Score shown = value sent with sendScore = best saved; best accuracy and combo saved.
9. Layout correct at 9:32, 9:16, 1:1, 16:9, 32:9; full song with keyboard only and touch only; at least 30 FPS.
10. No value hard-coded outside game_spec.json, no console errors, no network requests.
List the game_spec.json keys you added in this step, if any.
